name: Happy Dying
source:
You get a call from a mysterious Caller saying that today is your day to die! It's probably just a spam call-- so it's nothing to worry about! Still... something feels off... 

It's probably nothing! After all, you have a fun filled day ahead of you with your best friend Krill! You wouldn't want to make him worry, would you? He probably wouldn't handle it well...

Happy Dying is a VN focusing on phone conversations and friendship! Do your best to live and have a good time with Krill! Find out the Caller's real name, and what the deal is with the cat...

[from [url=https://theeleomelons.itch.io/happy-dying]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你接到神秘来电者的电话，说今天是你的死日！这可能只是一个垃圾电话——所以不用担心！还是……感觉有些不对劲…… 

大概没什么吧！毕竟，你将与最好的朋友Krill一起度过充满乐趣的一天！你不想让他担心吧？估计他也处理不好……

Happy Dying是一个专注于电话交谈和友谊的VN！尽全力与Krill一起生活并度过愉快的时光！找出来电者的真实姓名，以及这只猫的情况……

[来自[url=https://theeleomelons.itch.io/happy-dying]itch.io[/url]]
